title: Vanilla 3D Mace
description: A Resource/Texture Pack that makes the mace 3D but with vanilla style
body:
This Resource/Texture Pack makes the vanilla mace 3D in a vanilla style, with the main addition being the heavy core and a few small details that give it a more 3D feel.



Some people didn't like the vanilla game mace, i'm one of them. i get frustrated when i see a 3D heavy core turning 2D after crafting it into a mace... maybe that's just my problem...
